feature_contract.goal: Deliver an integrated, aspect-and-extent-aware Quest3 responsive interface: stereo-safe driving HUD, correctly proportioned main and paused menus, and readable native F11 overlay through reset and fallback transitions.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Exact original speed/time/position HUD remains edge anchored with safe stereo bounds while center/world producer ownership remains unchanged.
ESC/pause vertical offset matches fast XYZRHW, independent-eye reset fallback and WVP shader routes at four tested viewport sizes.
Main menu keeps 4:3 letterboxing; external F11, world and gameplay HUD ignore pause offsets and preserve XR-specific font sizing.
Full DX9Ex Active Win32 build/package, Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact pass on the same material SHA with no CI skip.

notes: C2 code and integrated regression added in one material commit. The whole Issue #119 feature is not HMD accepted. Update this record only after exact-SHA GitHub CI; never confuse bookkeeping SHA with validation-bearing result SHA.
